Symptoms of meningitis may include fever, headache, stiff neck, and confusion. In some cases, the infection may be mild or localized, which can lead to delays in diagnosis and treatment. The infection can affect anyone, regardless of age, and those traveling to areas with high rates of meningococcal disease, such as the meningitis belt in sub‑Saharan Africa, are at an increased risk.
